rationale: emailservice latency-90 rose from 0.0047 to 0.1454 (z=+601) and latency-50 from 0.003 to 0.0417 (z=+254), by far the largest anomalies, while its CPU, memory and socket metrics did not rise (cpu -10%, mem -5.5%, socket 3 to 2.5), which fits an injected delay rather than resource exhaustion. emailservice is a callee of checkoutservice, which fits the frontend external errors (z=+6.42). The traces and logs are uninformative: the listed paths do not include emailservice and no log lines were available, so confidence is medium.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect emailservice for network delay injection or slow dependencies (e.g. tc netem rules, slow SMTP/upstream calls) and remove the source of delay; add a timeout or circuit breaker on checkoutservice's call to emailservice so order flow does not block on it.
